items.summary: Deliver the KStack Secret Broker at the 93% closure gate
items.description: Design, review, implement, and qualify opaque-handle secret use so Claude and Codex never receive secret values.

items.summary: Automate Jira roadmap population during repository onboarding
items.description: Bind roadmap work items into delivery-stack preview, approval, apply, read-back, and reconciliation so a verified Jira space is not empty.

items.summary: Implement and qualify the release automation runtime
items.description: Turn the validated M1-M7 release design into a staged, observable, rollback-aware runtime and qualify it against a real target.

items.summary: Expand and qualify host breadth across coding agents
items.description: Complete portable host adapters, truthful capability projection, and qualification across supported coding-agent environments.

items.summary: Deliver the remaining domain-breadth packs independently
items.description: Design, implement, and qualify each approved domain pack as its own bounded workstream without weakening the core lifecycle.
Increase enforceable action coverage while preserving host truth, deny-only Codex behavior, and owner-controlled rollback.

items.summary: Mature GitHub and Jira backed KStack memory
items.description: Exercise durable memory with real accepted artifacts, deterministic retrieval, safe ingestion, and cross-session qualification without Ollama.

items.summary: Qualify secure token-use reduction for unattended runs
items.description: Complete the isolated benchmark, implement only proven reductions, and preserve review quality and security during overnight automation.

items.summary: Build a multi-repository qualification and adoption record
items.description: Exercise KStack across additional repositories and operators, retain comparable evidence, and close packaging or onboarding defects found in use.
